name: ne-money-transfer-tax-repeal
description: Niger 2026 money-deposit and transfer tax repeal review: identify the 21 August 2026 cutoff, distinguish former TDTA tax from operator fees and other taxes, and prepare evidence for a charge review. Use this Guide when a statement includes the former deposit/transfer levy or a historic rate is being quoted as current. It records the enacted pre-repeal scope, exemptions and whole-amount rate boundary only for transactions whose former-law applicability is established. Two executable cases compare historic amounts with post-repeal treatment. It does not establish an automatic refund, a historical filing deadline or an exemption from the separate cash-payment tax. No accountant has attested to this draft.
